finding.title: No-overwrite checks had publication races
finding.attack: A concurrent writer created the declared-new destination after the initial exists check and immediately before os.replace.
finding.consequence: Backup/restore and head-witness creation could silently overwrite a concurrently created destination despite their no-overwrite contract.
finding.required_repair: Publish the fully fsynced temporary file through one atomic create-if-absent operation and fail closed when the destination already exists at publication time.

nonclaim: Deterministic local race injection only; it does not establish a remote attacker or complete filesystem crash-consistency assurance.
